Transport and tipping

Asbestos disposal, wrapped, tracked and tipped at a licensed facility

Safe wrapping, transport and disposal of asbestos material at licensed facilities, with the dockets handed back to you. Asbestos does not go to a general waste facility, it is not recycled, and the paperwork that proves where it went is part of the job rather than an afterthought. Tell us what has been removed and roughly how much, and we will arrange wrapping, transport and tipping.

0456 220 552

Removal by licensed asbestos removalists. Max holds demolition licence AD214737

Six things have to be settled first, and not all of them are ours

Most jobs that run late run late on this list rather than on the work itself. Each line says who owns it.

The detail

Why disposal is a bigger line than people expect

  • It is priced at the gate. Licensed facilities charge by weight or volume for asbestos, at rates well above general waste.
  • There are fewer facilities. Which means the cartage distance is often longer, and the distance is part of the price.
  • It cannot be mixed. Asbestos material travels on its own. Putting it in with general waste contaminates the whole load and the whole load is then charged as asbestos.
  • It cannot be compacted. Breaking it down to fit more in is exactly the thing the wrapping exists to prevent.
  • Soil is heavy. Asbestos contaminated soil generates tonnage quickly, which is why it is priced separately from sheeting.
  • The dockets are part of the deliverable. They are what proves the material went where it was supposed to, and they cannot be reconstructed later.

Before you book

What people ask about this one

Can I put asbestos in a skip?
Not in a general waste skip. It has to be wrapped, labelled, transported and received by a facility licensed for it. Putting it in a mixed skip contaminates the entire load.
Is asbestos recycled?
No. It is buried at a facility licensed to receive it. There is no recovery pathway for it in the way there is for concrete, steel or timber.
How is it priced?
By weight or volume at the facility, plus the cartage. The survey quantity is what makes that estimable before the job rather than after it.
Can you dispose of material somebody else removed?
Only if it has been wrapped and labelled to the requirement by a licensed removalist. We are not able to take unwrapped material off a site.
What do I get at the end?
The disposal dockets from the licensed facility. Keep them with the clearance certificate.
